intent: Apply ALL prior supported findings and user-approved directions to V3 without reactivating disproven hypotheses or waiving established risk gates.

lessons.finding: 0/1731 V2R4 initial BUY, 0 paper trades, not a scanner uptime result
lessons.implementation: economic hard gate; no claimed success without cost-net prospectively proven actual fills

lessons.finding: after 1-3h new base, old 7/30d move must not permanently kill a genuinely new opportunity
lessons.implementation: fresh separately known-at bar series after initial EXTENDED; require price reclaim/new base, not chase

lessons.finding: second impulse/pullback rebuild under new risk plan
lessons.implementation: new time-stamped 1-3h contiguous consolidation and last closed 15m reclaim; preserves full independent evaluator gate

lessons.finding: temporarily uneconomic entry should be distinguished from dead setup
lessons.implementation: original EXTENDED REJECT/WAIT acts as historical anchor; later genuinely new observed reclaim may authorize separately approved fresh full recheck

lessons.finding: resistance caution should not permanently end truly watchable re-entry
lessons.implementation: reclaim must close above prior base high; structural confirmation not assumed merely from last price

lessons.finding: 946 of 1086 initial WAIT reached expiry without real recheck; 127 true rechecks 0 BUY
lessons.implementation: do not change active WAIT or TTL in B; separately queue bounded expiry recheck eligibility hypothesis; no combined change

lessons.finding: single frozen BUY selector accepts no valid buys despite better scanner
lessons.implementation: one distinct eligibility path to a full fresh model review; never count review as buy or fill

lessons.finding: 0/1731 actual initial evaluator candidates had structured PIT 1m/5m/15m, volume, ATR & local low input
lessons.implementation: reuses strict existing coin evidence handoff for later new snapshot; mandatory source freshness; source gaps flagged UNKNOWN

lessons.finding: BAT/USELESS validation skipped before a model; technical errors are not REJECTs
lessons.implementation: fail closed when required core evidence absent; log safe category in future separate trials, no replay of spent batch

lessons.finding: missing optional news/smart money/derivatives must not be hidden hard veto
lessons.implementation: optional sources are strictly contextual, not required for review eligibility; don't invent missing data

only objective proof of new reclaim and core execution/risk fields can block research eligibility; additional discretionary soft factors remain contextual for later full evaluator; no unapproved quantitative score

lessons.finding: no static pair blacklist/false account-private blocking
lessons.implementation: pair EUR and core ticker validated; full future evaluator must independently check current Kraken public online Spot-EUR and order minimums

lessons.finding: single V2R3 stopped trade -3.09% net; gross missed MFE != positive edge
lessons.implementation: 0.6% taker each side, fresh ask/spread and slippage remain in full BUY evaluation; review cannot generate order or optimistic fill

lessons.finding: valid stop below ask and stage2 trigger above ask required
lessons.implementation: base low is descriptive stop-reference only, never stops/positions/orders; full evaluator must price a valid risk plan

lessons.finding: score association with MFE and close is near zero
lessons.implementation: score has no automatic permission to buy or size

lessons.finding: MFE highs may overlap losses and pair-cluster episodes
lessons.implementation: preregistered PIT only, entry-fill-stop Stage2 costs and time-ordered MAE/MFE, pair/time clustered 6h/24h followup for later shadow
stratify economic evidence before selecting winner, no new time filter created

lessons.finding: active source evaluation and V3 H2-H11 need empirical readiness
lessons.implementation: no automatic simultaneous H3/H6 or H10 buy vote; reuse sources based on known-at and measurable incremental value; never blindly bundle all

lessons.finding: frozen V2R4, single writer, <=1 strategy shadow, no real orders
lessons.implementation: offline pure no-I/O/no-model candidate, separate explicit gate before any new shadow or paper, no live orders

next_decision: Once code/CI PASS and original learning PR #157 is reconciled, select the ONE inactive B policy candidate for independently authorized, bounded prospective evidence collection; no auto start or live changes.
